title: Truck-Size Restocking Fee on Trial Refunds — Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty
content:
Truck-size lines carry a restocking fee taken from the Tire Sets & Treadwear Limited Warranty trial refund, following the line and the days kept (calendar days from the install date to today).

| Line | Days kept | Restocking fee |
|---|---|---|
| new-tire (original) tread depth at least 14/32 in — the Crestline Highway Terrain LT 65K Treadwear Warranty line (14/32 in) | more than half of the trial days (more than 22.5 of 45) | 5% of the tire price paid |
| same line | half of the trial days or fewer | 2% of the tire price paid |
| any other line (10/32, 10/32, 11/32, 11/32, 11/32 in new depth) | any | nothing |

**Both sides (hypothetical 65K-line set, tire price paid $800.00):** returned on day 22 — $16.00; on day 23 — $40.00.
